scenes.title: EyeWash Toon Break: Delivery Loop (optional insert)
scenes.description: CLUBHOUSE CORNER CRT → EYEWASH CARTOON — NIGHT. Hand-drawn early-1990s Warner Bros. TV cel style; a deliberate break from photoreal, like the Marble Tick Tack bridge. Push into the CRT (Biscuit is the only one watching). Toon Pizza Guy sprints past a repeating background of house, cat, skeleton, and blue bins, with a dead-still face. Toon Lillith and Rubella lecture on the run cycle in held drawings ("Eight drawings, repeated until morale improves" / "The bin is still the wrong blue"). Skid, dust cloud, two knocks, hard cut to the real door. ~40s; cut if the meeting runs long. Needs toon model sheets (characters/model-sheets/). Full beats and all four prompts: episodes/episode-04/scenes.md.
